Indeed: interview time slot duration

Hiring event setup, employer side. Measured 29 Sep 2026. Reference for the JobFairX team. The images are frames from Indeed's own setup video.

Indeed offers two choices: 30 minutes and 60 minutes. There is no 15-minute choice.

The field is labelled Interview time slot duration and is a required drop-down menu. The next field asks how many interviews the team can conduct during each time slot.

The fields, in screen order

  1. Team availability: interview date, time zone, begin time, end time. Plus and minus buttons add or remove a second block of hours on the same day. Times are offered in 30-minute steps.
  2. Add interview date: adds another day, with a Delete date button.
  3. Advertising start date.
  4. Interview time slot duration: 30 min or 60 min.
  5. Interviews the team can conduct during each time slot: a number. Indeed then shows how many candidates to expect per slot.
  6. Interviewer email addresses.
